errors.text_span: beispielsweise beträgt der Wert für Welt-BIP in den 2000er Jahren 3,9 %, während der Wert für Exporte Deutschlands in denselben Jahren 5,4 % beträgt.
errors.evidence: The machine description incorrectly states the value for Exporte Deutschlands in the 2000er Jahre as 5.4%, but the figure shows it as 5.3%.
The machine description does not mention the presence of the legend explicitly located below the chart.
The machine description does not mention the specific colors used for each indicator (e.g., 'dunkelgrün' for Welt-BIP, 'hellgrün' for Welthandel, etc.).
The machine description does not explicitly state that the chart illustrates the average percentage values of the four economic indicators over the three decades.
